name: Tahara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tahara city emblem in blue and green: a stylised device of blue horizontal lines above a green ring.
history: Municipal flag of Tahara, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Tahara city emblem — a stylised device of blue horizontal lines above a green ring
